function: Sliding Transformer detects QPSK symbols without CSI in an uplink SIMO-OFDM ISAC receiver; AOA and delay are then estimated with LS plus MUSIC, which is not learned (p. 2-3).
system: Uplink SIMO-OFDM ISAC: UE with Nt=1 antenna, BS with Nr=8 antennas, M=64 subcarriers, QPSK, static target; no RIS; carrier frequency not stated (p. 2-3).
method: Transformer-encoder network (4 layers, one head, ReZero residuals, no positional encoding) on a sliding window of P symbols; supervised cross-entropy, trained from scratch, individually per SNR (p. 2-4).
data_channel: Own simulator: random QPSK symbols, Rayleigh-style random attenuation, random real delays and steering vectors from a normal distribution; 64 carriers; no standard channel model or measurements (p. 3).
test_conditions: Same channel realisations for training and testing; second case tests CSI differing up to 10% (random factor 0.9-1.1) from training; models trained individually for each SNR (p. 4).
baselines: Non-learned: LS channel estimation with CSI-based detection; learned: SBRNN (sliding bidirectional RNN, refs. [7], [8]), compared in SER and training samples (p. 4).
metrics: Symbol error rate versus SNR; training samples and training time to reach 90% accuracy; processing time; AOA error in degrees and delay error in meters versus SNR (p. 4-5).
complexity: Time complexity O(4nd^2) for the Transformer versus O(2n^2d) for Bi-LSTM; processing time 0.023 s versus 0.006 s; training 142 s versus 351 s (Table I, p. 4).
q1_support: p. 3: "Attenuation is randomly generated as a rayleigh fading style". Custom simulator with random delays and steering vectors; no 3GPP, DeepMIMO, or measured data is used.
q2_support: p. 4: "the training and testing channel realisations (the CSI simulated) have a difference of at most 10%". Only a CSI-error perturbation, which the criterion excludes; other cases are retrained ("individually trained for each SNR").
q3_support: p. 4: "the two AI-based techniques and a non-AI CSI-based symbol detection algorithm using Least Squares channel estimation (LS)". Fig. 4 compares SER of STransformer with SBRNN and LS.
q4_support: p. 4: "one-head Transformer encoder has a time complexity of" O(4*n*d^2) versus O(2*n^2*d) for Bi-LSTM; Table I gives training and processing times.
q5_support: p. 3: "Simulations are done to a set of data symbols randomly genenerated from a normal distribution". Own simulated data; the text has no code or data link and no public dataset.
notes: PDF is the IEEE accepted author's version (watermark p. 1), given as preprint. Area 1: only symbol detection is learned; AOA and delay use LS plus MUSIC (p. 3), not learned, so area 5 (ISAC receiver) is the alternative for the reviewer. The only train-test mismatch is the 10% CSI perturbation (p. 4), treated as CSI error; the paper calls it a generalisation test (p. 5). Fig. 4 SNR axis spans -30 to 10 dB (read from page image).
